<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    堆叠柱状图模板
    用途: 多类别构成对比、占比趋势分析
    适用场景: 收入构成、成本分解、市场份额变化
    支持: 5组数据 × 4个类别（可调整）
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="stackShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.2"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>各季度收入构成分析</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2024-2025年度 · 单位：百万元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- Y轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="550" x2="1100" y2="550" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="470" x2="1100" y2="470" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="390" x2="1100" y2="390" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="310" x2="1100" y2="310" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="230" x2="1100" y2="230" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="150" x2="1100" y2="150" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- Y轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="125" y="555" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>0</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="475" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>100</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="395" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>200</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="315" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>300</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="235" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>400</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="125" y="155" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>500</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- X轴和Y轴 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="150" x2="140" y2="550" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="550" x2="1100" y2="550" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 堆叠柱子 - Q1 2024 (总高320, 按比例: 产品A 120, 产品B 100, 产品C 60, 产品D 40) -->
        <g filter="url(#stackShadow)">
            <rect x="200" y="422" width="80" height="128" fill="#2196F3"/>
            <rect x="200" y="342" width="80" height="80" fill="#4CAF50"/>
            <rect x="200" y="294" width="80" height="48" fill="#FF9800"/>
            <rect x="200" y="262" width="80" height="32" fill="#9C27B0"/>

        <text x="240" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q1'24</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="240" y="247" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>320</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 堆叠柱子 - Q2 2024 (总高360) -->
        <g filter="url(#stackShadow)">

            <rect x="380" y="262" width="80" height="56" fill="#FF9800"/>
            <rect x="380" y="222" width="80" height="40" fill="#9C27B0"/>
        </g>
        <text x="420" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q2'24</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="420" y="207" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>360</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 堆叠柱子 - Q3 2024 (总高400) -->
        <g filter="url(#stackShadow)">
            <rect x="560" y="390" width="80" height="160" fill="#2196F3"/>

            <rect x="560" y="230" width="80" height="64" fill="#FF9800"/>
            <rect x="560" y="182" width="80" height="48" fill="#9C27B0"/>
        </g>
        <text x="600" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q3'24</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="600" y="167" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>400</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 堆叠柱子 - Q4 2024 (总高420) -->
        <g filter="url(#stackShadow)">
            <rect x="740" y="382" width="80" height="168" fill="#2196F3"/>
            <rect x="740" y="278" width="80" height="104" fill="#4CAF50"/>
            <rect x="740" y="206" width="80" height="72" fill="#FF9800"/>

        <text x="780" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q4'24</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="780" y="143" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>420</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 堆叠柱子 - Q1 2025 (总高480) -->
        <g filter="url(#stackShadow)">
            <rect x="920" y="358" width="80" height="192" fill="#2196F3"/>
            <rect x="920" y="246" width="80" height="112" fill="#4CAF50"/>
            <rect x="920" y="166" width="80" height="80" fill="#FF9800"/>
            <rect x="920" y="110" width="80" height="56" fill="#9C27B0"/>
        </g>
        <text x="960" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>Q1'25</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="960" y="95" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>480</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend" transform="translate(1120, 200)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="140" height="180" rx="8" fill="#F8F9FA" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1"/>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    KPI 卡片模板 - 2×2 布局（CRAP 优化版）
    用途: 展示关键业绩指标
    适用场景: 财务指标、业务数据看板、增长率展示
    优化: 强化对齐、对比、重复、亲密性原则
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 卡片阴影 - 更精致柔和 -->
        <filter id="cardShadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="6"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="3" result="offsetblur"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.15"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
        
        <!-- 渐变背景 - 增加层次感 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#F8F9FA;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#ECF0F1;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 标题区域 - 增强对比 -->
    <text x="60" y="75" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="36" font-weight="700" fill="#1A252F" letter-spacing="-0.5">
        <tspan>关键业绩指标</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="16" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>Key Performance Indicators</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- KPI 卡片布局 2×2 - 统一间距 40px -->
    
    <!-- 卡片 1 - 左上 (收入增长) -->
    <g filter="url(#cardShadow)">
        <!-- 卡片背景 - 更圆润的圆角 -->
        <rect x="60" y="150" width="560" height="250" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- 左侧色块指示器 - 更粗更醒目 -->
        <rect x="76" y="170" width="8" height="70" rx="4" fill="#2196F3"/>
        
        <!-- 指标名称 - 统一左边距 100px -->
        <text x="100" y="190" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368" letter-spacing="0.2">
            <tspan>总收入</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="100" y="213" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#9AA0A6">
            <tspan>Total Revenue</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 主数值 - 增强视觉权重 -->
        <text x="100" y="285" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="64" font-weight="700" fill="#1A252F" letter-spacing="-1">
            <tspan>¥2.45</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="310" y="285" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="28" font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368">
            <tspan>亿</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 趋势指示 - 优化间距和对齐 -->
        <circle cx="110" cy="340" r="18" fill="#E8F5E9"/>
        <polygon points="110,333 116,347 104,347" fill="#27AE60"/>
        <text x="140" y="349" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#27AE60">
            <tspan>+18.5%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 同比说明 - 更紧凑的分组 -->
        <text x="245" y="349" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#9AA0A6">
            <tspan>较去年同期</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片 2 - 右上 (用户数量) -->
    <g filter="url(#cardShadow)">
        <!-- 卡片背景 -->
        <rect x="660" y="150" width="560" height="250" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- 左侧色块指示器 -->
        <rect x="676" y="170" width="8" height="70" rx="4" fill="#4CAF50"/>
        
        <!-- 指标名称 -->
        <text x="700" y="190" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368" letter-spacing="0.2">
            <tspan>活跃用户</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="700" y="213" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#9AA0A6">
            <tspan>Active Users</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 主数值 -->
        <text x="700" y="285" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="64" font-weight="700" fill="#1A252F" letter-spacing="-1">
            <tspan>128.3</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="930" y="285" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="28" font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368">
            <tspan>万</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 趋势指示 -->
        <circle cx="710" cy="340" r="18" fill="#E8F5E9"/>
        <polygon points="710,333 716,347 704,347" fill="#27AE60"/>
        <text x="740" y="349" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#27AE60">
            <tspan>+12.3%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 同比说明 -->
        <text x="845" y="349" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#9AA0A6">
            <tspan>月同比增长</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片 3 - 左下 (客单价) -->
    <g filter="url(#cardShadow)">
        <!-- 卡片背景 -->
        <rect x="60" y="440" width="560" height="250" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- 左侧色块指示器 -->
        <rect x="76" y="460" width="8" height="70" rx="4" fill="#FF9800"/>
        
        <!-- 指标名称 -->
        <text x="100" y="480" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368" letter-spacing="0.2">
            <tspan>平均客单价</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="100" y="503" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#9AA0A6">
            <tspan>Avg Order Value</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 主数值 -->
        <text x="100" y="575" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="64" font-weight="700" fill="#1A252F" letter-spacing="-1">
            <tspan>¥432</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 趋势指示 - 下降趋势 -->
        <circle cx="110" cy="630" r="18" fill="#FFEBEE"/>
        <polygon points="110,643 116,629 104,629" fill="#E74C3C"/>
        <text x="140" y="639" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#E74C3C">
            <tspan>-3.2%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 同比说明 -->
        <text x="235" y="639" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#9AA0A6">
            <tspan>环比上月</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片 4 - 右下 (转化率) -->
    <g filter="url(#cardShadow)">
        <!-- 卡片背景 -->
        <rect x="660" y="440" width="560" height="250" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E8EAED" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <!-- 左侧色块指示器 -->
        <rect x="676" y="460" width="8" height="70" rx="4" fill="#9C27B0"/>
        
        <!-- 指标名称 -->
        <text x="700" y="480" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#5F6368" letter-spacing="0.2">
            <tspan>转化率</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="700" y="503" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#9AA0A6">
            <tspan>Conversion Rate</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 主数值 -->
        <text x="700" y="575" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="64" font-weight="700" fill="#1A252F" letter-spacing="-1">
            <tspan>8.7%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 趋势指示 -->
        <circle cx="710" cy="630" r="18" fill="#E8F5E9"/>
        <polygon points="710,623 716,637 704,637" fill="#27AE60"/>
        <text x="740" y="639" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#27AE60">
            <tspan>+0.8%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 同比说明 -->
        <text x="835" y="639" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#9AA0A6">
            <tspan>百分点提升</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源标注 - 优化样式 -->
    <text x="1160" y="705" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="13" fill="#9AA0A6" text-anchor="end">
        <tspan>数据截至 2025年11月 | Data as of Nov 2025</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>

    <!--

            <tspan>亿</tspan>

              font-size="16" fill="#9AA0A6">

        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片 4 - 右下 (转化率) -->

# Ultra Sound Money - Design Spec

## I. Project Information

| Item | Value |
| ---- | ----- |
| **Project Name** | Ultra Sound Money |
| **Canvas Format** | PPT 16:9 (1280×720) |
| **Page Count** | 8 |
| **Design Style** | B) General Consulting |
| **Target Audience** | Crypto-native investors and Ethereum ecosystem participants |
| **Use Case** | Investment thesis presentation |
| **Created Date** | 2026-04-20 |

---

## II. Canvas Specification

| Property | Value |
| -------- | ----- |
| **Format** | PPT 16:9 |
| **Dimensions** | 1280×720 |
| **viewBox** | `0 0 1280 720` |
| **Margins** | Left/Right 40px, Top 20px, Bottom 40px |
| **Content Area** | x: 40-1240, y: 40-680 |

---

## III. Visual Theme

### Theme Style

- **Style**: Exhibit (dark theme, conclusion-first)
- **Theme**: Dark theme
- **Tone**: Data-forward, analytical, conviction-driven, premium crypto

### Color Scheme

| Role | HEX | Purpose |
| ---- | --- | ------- |
| **Background** | `#0D1117` | Page background (dark pages) |
| **Content bg** | `#FFFFFF` | Content page background |
| **Secondary bg** | `#1F2937` | Card background on dark pages |
| **Primary** | `#7C3AED` | Ethereum purple — titles, key sections |
| **Accent** | `#D4AF37` | Gold highlights, dividers |
| **Secondary accent** | `#1E40AF` | Gradient start, secondary elements |
| **Body text** | `#FFFFFF` | Text on dark backgrounds |
| **Body black** | `#111827` | Text on light backgrounds |
| **Secondary text** | `#9CA3AF` | Subtitles, descriptions |
| **Tertiary text** | `#6B7280` | Footer, timestamps |
| **Border/divider** | `#374151` | Borders on dark backgrounds |
| **Success** | `#4CAF50` | Positive/issuance indicators |
| **Warning** | `#EF5350` | Burn/negative indicators |

### Gradient Scheme

```xml
<linearGradient id="topGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
  <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1E40AF"/>
  <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7C3AED"/>
</linearGradient>
```

---

## IV. Typography System

### Font Plan

**Recommended preset**: P5 (English-primary)

| Role | English | Fallback |
| ---- | ------- | -------- |
| **Title** | Arial | Helvetica Neue, sans-serif |
| **Body** | Calibri | Arial, sans-serif |
| **Code** | Consolas | Monaco |
| **Emphasis** | Arial Black | Arial Bold |

**Font stack**: `Arial, "Helvetica Neue", Calibri, sans-serif`

### Font Size Hierarchy

**Baseline**: Body font size = 18px (dense data content)

| Purpose | Size | Weight |
| ------- | ---- | ------ |
| Cover title | 52px | Bold |
| Page title | 28px | Bold |
| Section title | 22px | Bold |
| Subtitle | 20px | SemiBold |
| **Body** | **18px** | Regular |
| Annotation | 14px | Regular |
| Page number | 12px | Regular |

---

## V. Layout Principles

### Page Structure

- **Top bar**: y=0, h=6px — Blue-purple gradient decorative bar
- **Header**: y=20, h=80px — Key message / Exhibit takeaway bar
- **Content Area**: y=100, h=520px — Main content
- **Footer**: y=660, h=60px — Source, confidential label, page number

### Spacing Specification

| Element | Value |
| ------- | ----- |
| Card gap | 24px |
| Content block gap | 28px |
| Card padding | 24px |
| Card border radius | 8px |
| Icon-text gap | 10px |

---

## VI. Icon Usage Specification

### Source

- **Built-in icon library**: `templates/icons/` (640+ icons)
- **Usage method**: `<use data-icon="icon-name" .../>` placeholder

### Icon Inventory

| Purpose | Icon Name | Page |
| ------- | --------- | ---- |
| Growth/trend | `arrow-trend-up` | Slides 01, 02, 06 |
| Decline | `arrow-trend-down` | Slide 02 |
| Money/value | `dollar` | Slides 01, 07 |
| Fire/burn | `fire` | Slides 03, 04 |
| Shield/staking | `shield` | Slide 05 |
| Lock/security | `lock-closed` | Slide 05 |
| Chart/data | `chart-bar` | Slide 02 |
| Target | `target` | Slide 08 |
| Checkmark | `circle-checkmark` | Slide 08 |
| Warning | `triangle-exclamation` | Slide 08 |
| Clock | `clock` | Slide 05 |
| Lightbulb | `lightbulb` | Slide 08 |
| Gem | `gem` | Slide 07 |
| Bolt | `bolt` | Slide 03 |
| Layers | `layers` | Slide 07 |

---

## VII. Chart Reference List

| Chart Type | Reference Template | Used In | Purpose |
| ---------- | ------------------ | ------- | ------- |
| waterfall_chart | `templates/charts/waterfall_chart.svg` | Slide 02 | Issuance vs burn waterfall |
| horizontal_bar_chart | `templates/charts/horizontal_bar_chart.svg` | Slide 04 | Burn categories ranking |
| donut_chart | `templates/charts/donut_chart.svg` | Slide 05 | Validator reward composition |
| line_chart | `templates/charts/line_chart.svg` | Slide 06 | 200-year supply projection |
| stacked_bar_chart | `templates/charts/stacked_bar_chart.svg` | Slide 07 | TVS composition breakdown |

---

## VIII. Image Resource List

N/A — No images needed.

---

## IX. Content Outline

### Part 1: Context

#### Slide 01 — Cover

- **Layout**: Cover template (01_cover.svg)
- **Title**: Ultra Sound Money
- **Subtitle**: Ethereum's Post-Merge Supply Dynamics & Monetary Premium
- **Key stats**: Supply ~121.6M ETH | Gas ~0.1 Gwei | ETH ~$2,243
- **Date**: April 2026

#### Slide 02 — Supply Change Snapshot

- **Layout**: Content template — waterfall chart
- **Exhibit bar**: "Only 1% of new issuance offset by burns — ETH supply growing at +0.83%/yr"
- **Chart**: waterfall_chart — Issuance (+19,638 ETH) vs Burn (192 ETH) = Net +19,446 ETH
- **Content**: Current supply 121,603,980 ETH, offset ratio 0.01x, annualized +0.83%/yr

### Part 2: Mechanics

#### Slide 03 — Gas & Burn Mechanics

- **Layout**: Content template — KPI cards + range display
- **Exhibit bar**: "Base gas at historic 0.1 Gwei average — 220x below equilibrium assumption"
- **Content**: EIP-1559 mechanism, gas range (min 0.0, max 1.3, avg 0.1 Gwei), blob gas (7.1M wei avg, 0.15 ETH total), 22 Gwei equilibrium vs 0.1 Gwei current

#### Slide 04 — Burn Leaderboard

- **Layout**: Content template — horizontal bar chart
- **Exhibit bar**: "DeFi and ETH transfers drive 85% of weekly burn activity"
- **Chart**: horizontal_bar_chart — DeFi 31, ETH transfers 22, Misc 4, NFTs 3, Contract creations 2, L2/MEV/Blobs 0
- **Content**: Top entries: ETH transfers 21.7 ETH, Tether 13.6 ETH

#### Slide 05 — Staking & Validator Economics

- **Layout**: Content template — donut chart + data cards
- **Exhibit bar**: "38.9M ETH staked (32% of supply) at 2.7% APR — tips and MEV near zero"
- **Chart**: donut_chart — Reward breakdown: Issuance 2.7%, Tips 0.1%, MEV 0.1%
- **Content**: 9.1M ETH locked avg 10.7 years, ~2,800 ETH/day PoS issuance

### Part 3: Outlook

#### Slide 06 — Supply Projections

- **Layout**: Content template — line chart
- **Exhibit bar**: "200-year model converges to 125.7M ETH equilibrium at 22 Gwei avg gas"
- **Chart**: line_chart — Supply trajectory from ~120M through eras to 125.7M equilibrium
- **Content**: Parameters: 39M staked, 22 Gwei, 1,037K ETH/yr issuance-burn balance, 2.7% staker rewards, 1.2% non-staker burn rate

#### Slide 07 — Flippening & Total Value Secured

- **Layout**: Content template — stacked bar + data table
- **Exhibit bar**: "ETH secures $307B+ in value — 18.7% of Bitcoin's market cap"
- **Chart**: stacked_bar_chart — TVS: ETH $272.76B, ERC20s $22.21B, NFTs $12.66B
- **Content**: Flippening ratios: BTC 18.7%, Gold 0.89%, USD 1.30%. Top ERC20s: Dai $4.41B, SHIB $3.51B. Top NFTs: CryptoPunks $2.13B

#### Slide 08 — Key Takeaways

- **Layout**: Content template — numbered key findings
- **Exhibit bar**: "Ultra sound money thesis intact — on-chain activity recovery is the critical variable"
- **Content**:
  1. ETH mildly inflationary at +0.83%/yr due to historic low gas (0.1 Gwei)
  2. Burn mechanism functional but requires sustained activity (22 Gwei target)
  3. 38.9M ETH staked (32%) creates major supply lock
  4. Long-term equilibrium at 125.7M ETH is structurally sound
  5. $307B+ TVS and 18.7% BTC market cap ratio = growing monetary premium

---

## X. Speaker Notes Requirements

- **File naming**: Match SVG names (e.g., `01_cover.md`)
- **Style**: Conversational, data-driven
- **Duration**: ~15 minutes total
- **Purpose**: Persuade / inform

---

## XI. Technical Constraints Reminder

### SVG Generation Must Follow:

1. viewBox: `0 0 1280 720`
2. Background uses `<rect>` elements
3. Text wrapping uses `<tspan>` (`<foreignObject>` FORBIDDEN)
4. Transparency uses `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity`; `rgba()` FORBIDDEN
5. FORBIDDEN: `clipPath`, `mask`, `<style>`, `class`, `foreignObject`
6. FORBIDDEN: `textPath`, `animate*`, `script`, `marker`/`marker-end`
7. Arrows use `<polygon>` triangles instead of `<marker>`

### PPT Compatibility Rules:

- `<g opacity="...">` FORBIDDEN; set on each child individually
- Inline styles only; external CSS and `@font-face` FORBIDDEN

---

## XII. Design Checklist

### Pre-generation

- [x] Content fits page capacity
- [x] Layout mode selected correctly
- [x] Colors used semantically

### Post-generation

- [ ] viewBox = `0 0 1280 720`
- [ ] No `<foreignObject>` elements
- [ ] All text readable (>=14px)
- [ ] Content within safe area
- [ ] Colors conform to spec

---

## XIII. Next Steps

1. ✅ Design spec complete
2. **Next step**: Invoke **Executor** role to generate SVGs (no AI images needed)

arguments.content:
# 01_cover

Welcome to our analysis of Ethereum's post-merge supply dynamics and the ultra sound money thesis. [Pause]

Today we're going to walk through the data behind ETH's monetary properties — from current supply mechanics to long-term equilibrium projections. We'll ground everything in the numbers from ultrasound.money: supply at 121.6 million ETH, base gas at a historic low of 0.1 Gwei, and ETH priced at $2,243.

Key points: ① Set the context for a data-driven ETH monetary analysis ② Frame current low-activity environment honestly ③ Signal analytical, conviction-driven approach
Duration: 1 minute

---

# 02_supply_snapshot

[Transition] Let's start with the headline number — what's actually happening to ETH supply right now?

Over the trailing 7 days, the network issued 19,638 ETH to validators but burned only 192 ETH through EIP-1559. That's a net addition of roughly 19,446 ETH, translating to an annualized growth rate of +0.83% per year. [Pause]

The critical metric here is the offset ratio: just 0.01x. That means burns are currently offsetting only about 1% of new issuance. This is a far cry from the deflationary dynamics the community was celebrating shortly after the merge.

Key points: ① Net supply change is +19,446 ETH over 7 days ② Offset ratio of 0.01x — burns cover just 1% of issuance ③ Current supply stands at 121,603,980 ETH
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 03_gas_burn_mechanics

[Transition] So why is the burn so low? It all comes down to gas prices.

The 7-day gas market shows an average of just 0.1 Gwei — with a minimum of zero and maximum of only 1.3 Gwei. To put this in perspective, the long-term equilibrium model assumes 22 Gwei average gas. That's a 220x gap between where we are and where we need to be for issuance and burn to balance. [Pause]

Blob gas, introduced via EIP-4844 for Layer 2 data availability, averaged about 7.1 million wei — contributing a trivial 0.15 ETH ($319) in total blob fee burn over 7 days. Recent blocks are burning between 0.00 and 0.01 ETH each.

The equation is simple: low gas equals low burn equals temporary supply inflation.

Key points: ① Gas at historic lows — 220x below equilibrium assumption ② Blob gas burn is negligible at $319 per week ③ PoS issuance ~2,800 ETH/day vs normalized burn ~2,200 ETH/day
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 04_burn_leaderboard

[Transition] Even at these historically low levels, we can see which activities are driving the burn.

DeFi leads with 31 ETH burned, followed by ETH transfers at 22 ETH. Together, these two categories account for roughly 85% of the week's total burn. Everything else — misc, NFTs, contract creations — contributed single digits or zero. [Pause]

Looking at the individual leaderboard, ETH transfers burned 21.74 ETH and Tether USDT was second at 13.55 ETH. L2, MEV, and blob fees all registered effectively zero burn. This tells us that when activity does return, DeFi and core value transfer will be the primary burn engines.

Key points: ① DeFi + ETH transfers = 85% of burn activity ② Total weekly burn only ~192 ETH ③ L2/MEV/blob contributions negligible at current levels
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 05_staking_economics

[Transition] Now let's look at the other side of the equation — where is all this ETH going?

38.9 million ETH is currently staked, representing 32% of total supply. Validators earn approximately 2.9% total APR, but the breakdown is revealing: 2.7% comes from protocol issuance, while tips and MEV each contribute just 0.1%. In a low-activity environment, validators are almost entirely dependent on issuance rewards. [Pause]

The scarcity engine is particularly noteworthy — 9.1 million ETH sits in staking contracts with an average lock duration of 10.7 years. This is a significant supply sink that amplifies any future burn recovery's impact on circulating supply.

Key points: ① 32% of supply locked in staking ② 93% of validator rewards come from issuance, not tips or MEV ③ 9.1M ETH locked for average 10.7 years creates structural scarcity
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 06_supply_projections

[Transition] So where does this all lead long-term?

The 200-year supply projection model converges to an equilibrium of 125.7 million ETH. At that point, issuance and burn balance at approximately 1.037 million ETH per year, assuming 39 million ETH staked and 22 Gwei average base gas. [Pause]

Looking at the historical trajectory, supply growth has flattened dramatically since the merge. We went from 5 ETH per block at genesis, through Byzantium's 3 and Constantinople's 2, through the introduction of EIP-1559 burn, to the complete removal of proof-of-work issuance at the merge.

For stakers, this means 2.7% annual issuance rewards. For non-stakers, the effective burn rate is 1.2% per year — meaning their holdings gradually become a smaller share of total supply. The path to equilibrium depends entirely on sustained on-chain activity.

Key points: ① Equilibrium at 125.7M ETH ② Requires 22 Gwei avg gas to balance at 1,037K ETH/year ③ Stakers earn 2.7%/yr while non-stakers face 1.2%/yr dilution
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 07_flippening_tvs

[Transition] Beyond supply mechanics, how is Ethereum's monetary premium evolving relative to competing assets?

ETH's market cap currently stands at 18.7% of Bitcoin's — meaningful progress but still early in the flippening journey. Against gold, we're at 0.89%, and against the USD money supply, 1.30%. [Pause]

Total Value Secured on Ethereum is over $307 billion. The vast majority — $272.76 billion — is native ETH. ERC20 tokens contribute $22.21 billion, led by Dai at $4.41 billion and Shiba Inu at $3.51 billion. NFTs add another $12.66 billion, with CryptoPunks alone at $2.13 billion. Over 6,000 community members actively track these metrics.

This growing TVS demonstrates that Ethereum isn't just a monetary asset — it's the security layer for a substantial and diversified financial ecosystem.

Key points: ① 18.7% of Bitcoin's market cap ② $307B+ total value secured across ETH, ERC20s, and NFTs ③ Growing monetary premium signals increasing institutional and ecosystem confidence
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 08_key_takeaways

[Transition] Let's bring it all together with five key takeaways.

First, ETH is currently mildly inflationary at +0.83% per year — this is a fact, driven by historically low gas prices, and we should be honest about it. [Pause]

Second, the burn mechanism works — it's just dormant. When activity returns and gas prices push toward the 22 Gwei equilibrium, deflation will re-engage.

Third, 38.9 million ETH staked with massive lock-up periods creates structural scarcity that amplifies any future burn recovery.

Fourth, the long-term equilibrium at 125.7 million ETH is mathematically sound. The model is robust; the variable is timing.

And fifth, with over $307 billion in total value secured and 18.7% of Bitcoin's market cap, Ethereum's monetary premium is real and growing. [Pause]

The ultra sound money thesis is structurally intact. Gas activity recovery is the critical catalyst — and when it returns, ETH's deflationary mechanics will re-engage with force.

Key points: ① Honest about current inflationary headwinds ② Burn mechanism is dormant, not broken ③ Structural thesis intact — activity recovery is the key catalyst
Duration: 2 minutes

Key points: ① Set the context for a data-driven ETH monetary analysis ② Frame current low-activity environment honestly ③ Signal analytical, conviction-driven approach
Duration: 1 minute

---

# 02_supply_snapshot

[Transition] Let's start with the headline number — what's actually happening to ETH supply right now?

Over the trailing 7 days, the network issued 19,638 ETH to validators but burned only 192 ETH through EIP-1559. That's a net addition of roughly 19,446 ETH, translating to an annualized growth rate of +0.83% per year. [Pause]

The critical metric here is the offset ratio: just 0.01x. That means burns are currently offsetting only about 1% of new issuance. This is a far cry from the deflationary dynamics the community was celebrating shortly after the merge.

Key points: ① Net supply change is +19,446 ETH over 7 days ② Offset ratio of 0.01x — burns cover just 1% of issuance ③ Current supply stands at 121,603,980 ETH
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 03_gas_burn_mechanics

[Transition] So why is the burn so low? It all comes down to gas prices.

The 7-day gas market shows an average of just 0.1 Gwei — with a minimum of zero and maximum of only 1.3 Gwei. To put this in perspective, the long-term equilibrium model assumes 22 Gwei average gas. That's a 220x gap between where we are and where we need to be for issuance and burn to balance. [Pause]

Blob gas, introduced via EIP-4844 for Layer 2 data availability, averaged about 7.1 million wei — contributing a trivial 0.15 ETH ($319) in total blob fee burn over 7 days. Recent blocks are burning between 0.00 and 0.01 ETH each.

The equation is simple: low gas equals low burn equals temporary supply inflation.

Key points: ① Gas at historic lows — 220x below equilibrium assumption ② Blob gas burn is negligible at $319 per week ③ PoS issuance ~2,800 ETH/day vs normalized burn ~2,200 ETH/day
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 04_burn_leaderboard

[Transition] Even at these historically low levels, we can see which activities are driving the burn.

DeFi leads with 31 ETH burned, followed by ETH transfers at 22 ETH. Together, these two categories account for roughly 85% of the week's total burn. Everything else — misc, NFTs, contract creations — contributed single digits or zero. [Pause]

Looking at the individual leaderboard, ETH transfers burned 21.74 ETH and Tether USDT was second at 13.55 ETH. L2, MEV, and blob fees all registered effectively zero burn. This tells us that when activity does return, DeFi and core value transfer will be the primary burn engines.

Key points: ① DeFi + ETH transfers = 85% of burn activity ② Total weekly burn only ~192 ETH ③ L2/MEV/blob contributions negligible at current levels
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 05_staking_economics

[Transition] Now let's look at the other side of the equation — where is all this ETH going?

38.9 million ETH is currently staked, representing 32% of total supply. Validators earn approximately 2.9% total APR, but the breakdown is revealing: 2.7% comes from protocol issuance, while tips and MEV each contribute just 0.1%. In a low-activity environment, validators are almost entirely dependent on issuance rewards. [Pause]

The scarcity engine is particularly noteworthy — 9.1 million ETH sits in staking contracts with an average lock duration of 10.7 years. This is a significant supply sink that amplifies any future burn recovery's impact on circulating supply.

Key points: ① 32% of supply locked in staking ② 93% of validator rewards come from issuance, not tips or MEV ③ 9.1M ETH locked for average 10.7 years creates structural scarcity
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 06_supply_projections

[Transition] So where does this all lead long-term?

The 200-year supply projection model converges to an equilibrium of 125.7 million ETH. At that point, issuance and burn balance at approximately 1.037 million ETH per year, assuming 39 million ETH staked and 22 Gwei average base gas. [Pause]

Looking at the historical trajectory, supply growth has flattened dramatically since the merge. We went from 5 ETH per block at genesis, through Byzantium's 3 and Constantinople's 2, through the introduction of EIP-1559 burn, to the complete removal of proof-of-work issuance at the merge.

For stakers, this means 2.7% annual issuance rewards. For non-stakers, the effective burn rate is 1.2% per year — meaning their holdings gradually become a smaller share of total supply. The path to equilibrium depends entirely on sustained on-chain activity.

Key points: ① Equilibrium at 125.7M ETH ② Requires 22 Gwei avg gas to balance at 1,037K ETH/year ③ Stakers earn 2.7%/yr while non-stakers face 1.2%/yr dilution
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 07_flippening_tvs

[Transition] Beyond supply mechanics, how is Ethereum's monetary premium evolving relative to competing assets?

ETH's market cap currently stands at 18.7% of Bitcoin's — meaningful progress but still early in the flippening journey. Against gold, we're at 0.89%, and against the USD money supply, 1.30%. [Pause]

Total Value Secured on Ethereum is over $307 billion. The vast majority — $272.76 billion — is native ETH. ERC20 tokens contribute $22.21 billion, led by Dai at $4.41 billion and Shiba Inu at $3.51 billion. NFTs add another $12.66 billion, with CryptoPunks alone at $2.13 billion. Over 6,000 community members actively track these metrics.

This growing TVS demonstrates that Ethereum isn't just a monetary asset — it's the security layer for a substantial and diversified financial ecosystem.

Key points: ① 18.7% of Bitcoin's market cap ② $307B+ total value secured across ETH, ERC20s, and NFTs ③ Growing monetary premium signals increasing institutional and ecosystem confidence
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 08_key_takeaways

[Transition] Let's bring it all together with five key takeaways.

First, ETH is currently mildly inflationary at +0.83% per year — this is a fact, driven by historically low gas prices, and we should be honest about it. [Pause]

Second, the burn mechanism works — it's just dormant. When activity returns and gas prices push toward the 22 Gwei equilibrium, deflation will re-engage.

Third, 38.9 million ETH staked with massive lock-up periods creates structural scarcity that amplifies any future burn recovery.

Fourth, the long-term equilibrium at 125.7 million ETH is mathematically sound. The model is robust; the variable is timing.

And fifth, with over $307 billion in total value secured and 18.7% of Bitcoin's market cap, Ethereum's monetary premium is real and growing. [Pause]

The ultra sound money thesis is structurally intact. Gas activity recovery is the critical catalyst — and when it returns, ETH's deflationary mechanics will re-engage with force.

Key points: ① Honest about current inflationary headwinds ② Burn mechanism is dormant, not broken ③ Structural thesis intact — activity recovery is the key catalyst
Duration: 2 minutes
